description: Canonical frame-preserving Livox MID-360 per-point training dataset
coordinate_frame: original LiDAR sensor frame for each recording

arrays.point_offset_s: float32 [P], point time relative to its frame timestamp
arrays.label: uint8 [P]: 0 unimpacted, 1 smoke impacted, 255 ignore
arrays.frame_index: int32 [P], zero-based frame within this chunk
arrays.frame_ptr: int64 [F+1], point slice for each frame
arrays.frame_time_s: float64 [F], frame timestamp relative to chunk/recording start

known_clean_policy: For condition=clean_control, valid pseudo-label false positives are exported as unimpacted; existing ignore labels remain ignored.
normalization: No normalization is applied; fit preprocessing on the training split only.
